query:
SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.slug, o.officeName, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sanad_office_services WHERE officeId = o.id) as serviceCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM office_availability WHERE officeId = o.id) as availabilityCount
FROM sanad_offices o
HAVING serviceCount > 0 AND availabilityCount > 0
LIMIT 5
